title: Stability & Expansion Charter

stability_questions.question: Apakah connect, expiry, revoke, degraded, outage, latency, dan disconnect cleanup per connector version tetap sehat?
Apakah callback, state, rotation, reauth, scope change, dan provider revoke selesai tanpa kehilangan sesi pengguna?
Apakah kuota yang ditampilkan cocok dengan pemakaian yang dilaporkan, tanpa angka basi atau presisi palsu?
Apakah queue, transfer, retry, conflict, backup terenkripsi, dan restore mempertahankan integritas data pengguna?
Apakah discovery, job, cancellation, usage, cost, fallback, dan privacy destination AI provider konsisten?
Apakah checkout, webhook, idempotency, invoice, entitlement, dan refund tetap benar tanpa pembayaran ganda?
Apakah OAuth, vault, session, permission, redirect, webhook, dan redaction log tetap aman tanpa kebocoran rahasia?
Apakah consent, destination, retention, deletion, disconnect, dan telemetry control tidak melewatkan data pengguna?
Apakah connector global tidak pernah mendapat akses otomatis ke data Novel atau Character dan transfer selalu eksplisit?
Apakah seluruh alur dapat diselesaikan dengan keyboard dan reader layar pada kontras yang memenuhi ambang?
Apakah render, refresh, scan lokal, chart, memori, dan cache tetap dalam anggaran resource?
Apakah timeout, circuit breaker, retry-after, queue recovery, dan kill switch memulihkan layanan tanpa kehilangan data?

expansion_budget.blocked_reason: no_certified_connector:0_of_32; expansion requires versioned certification evidence (118.39/118.42) before any connector may be added

exit_criteria.description: Release state is re-confirmed from the committed 117/118 evidence and never inferred from a local test.
Every declared stability question has a recorded answer or an explicit DEFERRED-EXTERNAL with evidence.
No connector was certified or exposed beyond the recorded expansion budget.
Every critical incident is resolved or its connector is disabled with a recorded recovery path.
The maintenance release decision (BUILD_1_3_1 / NO_PATCH) is recorded with artifact, upgrade, and rollback evidence.
The maintenance regression matrix ran green over the critical Account Center workflows.

claim_boundary: This record is the gate verdict over committed 118.1 evidence. A pass means the charter is complete and internally consistent; it does not observe anything, certify any connector, or activate any release.

The charter is written against the delayed release state (GA_DELAYED) with the approved corrective scope, so the observation window is declared and not executed and the expansion budget is zero new certified connectors out of 32 registered and 0 certified.
The gate reads the committed 118.1 entry gate and corrective scope approval directly; an unreadable witness or an unapproved corrective scope keeps the charter blocked rather than assumed.

Stability questions, stop conditions, and exit criteria are contracts to be executed by later steps (118.3 onward); no live telemetry, connector certification, provider exposure, or publication is performed or authorized here.
